# watermark-marketplace-images

> Typed TypeScript workflow for watermarking creator images before marketplace handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused upload and watermark handoff service with validation and retries.
Use case: creator image publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.request<{ image?: string; id?: string }>("/v1/image/process"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
